question: Solve \(2x-3(x-1)=-2(x+1)+7\). (Enter only the value of \(x\).)
solution: Expanding gives \(2x-3x+3=-2x-2+7\), or \(-x+3=-2x+5\). Transposing terms gives \(x=2\).
